blocks.raw: <Example>A Group 1 warehouse project with a PCC of ₱150M: Fee on first ₱50M = ₱50M × 5% = ₱2,500,000. Fee on next ₱50M (₱50M–₱100M bracket) = ₱50M × 4% = ₱2,000,000. Fee on remaining ₱50M (₱101M–₱200M bracket) = ₱50M × 3% = ₱1,500,000. Total fee = ₱6,000,000.</Example>

blocks.raw: <Tip>Memorize the groups as three clusters: **Complexity** (1-2-3 at 5-6-7% DAEDS), **Type** (4-5 at 10-12%), and **Special** (6-7 repetitive, 8 interiors at 15%, 9 renovations at 150%, 10 MDPE). The complexity cluster shares the sliding sclea; the others do not.</Tip>
